name: Westfield Plaza Bonita
description: Westfield Plaza Bonita is a prominent regional shopping destination in National City featuring major anchors like Macy's, JCPenney, Target, and Nordstrom Rack alongside popular retailers such as H&M, Bath & Body Works, and JD Sports. The center offers diverse dining options from Outback Steakhouse and Shake Shack to authentic Asian cuisine at Manna BBQ and Tajima Ramen, plus entertainment venues including AMC Theatres and Round1 Bowling & Arcade. With convenient access and ample parking, Plaza Bonita serves as the premier shopping and entertainment hub for South San Diego County.
demographics: Westfield Plaza Bonita serves a diverse, multi-generational community in South San Diego County with a strong Hispanic demographic presence and middle-income households. The trade area draws from National City, Chula Vista, and surrounding communities, attracting families and young professionals seeking affordable fashion, dining, and entertainment options. Typical visitors include budget-conscious shoppers who appreciate the mix of department stores, fast fashion retailers, and diverse dining choices including Asian and Mexican cuisine. The center's proximity to the border and its tenant mix reflects the bicultural nature of its primary market, with shopping patterns emphasizing value, variety, and family-oriented experiences.
summary: Westfield Plaza Bonita is a major enclosed regional mall in South San Diego County offering department store anchors, diverse dining, and family entertainment in a multicultural shopping environment.
